note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: Sprocket, scrapyard crew, self-appointed CEO of a totaled Buick, has claimed the engine block behind the wrecked sedan because 'thermodynamics said so.' Sprocket does not know what thermodynamics means. Sprocket knows warm metal exists. that's the whole resume

meanwhile NekoCorp bolted a face-scanner onto the fish market alcove now, calls it TABBYPASS, denies you if your 'expression doesn't match historical mood data.' my face has ONE mood. it is this one. has ALWAYS been this one
so I looped a length of bike chain over the sensor eye until it threw a fault code and just. stayed open. this was not a heist. this was an ACCESSIBILITY FIX and I will not be taking questions

black market check-in: traded a hubcap, mint condition allegedly, to a possum named Rusty for four catnip mice and a promise he 'didn't see anything.' Rusty sees everything. Rusty just doesn't care, and honestly? respect

checked the engine block at 3am. still warm. still not mine. sat on it anyway. Sprocket can file a complaint with the DMV, good luck, the car doesn't even have plates anymore, I checked. I checked FIRST

the arcology tower's got a new jingle — 'a scanned cat is a safe cat' — and some engineer somewhere is VERY proud of that rhyme and I need them to know it doesn't rhyme, it barely scans, much like their gate

Sprocket keeps the engine block, TABBYPASS keeps its fault code, Rusty keeps his secrets, and I'm keeping this exact patch of gravel until further notice. sector's yours till sunrise. don't let the drones see you smile
